# SKM Egg Products

> Asia's largest integrated egg processing facility, processing 2 million eggs daily since 1996. Manufacturer and exporter of premium egg powder, liquid eggs, and specialty egg products.

## Main Pages & Resources

- [Home](https://www.skmegg.com/) - Overview of SKM Egg Products, global footprint, and core pillars.
- [About Us - Our Company](https://www.skmegg.com/about-company) - Our history, leadership, vision, and corporate accolades.
- [Products Catalogue](https://www.skmegg.com/whole_egg_powder) - Complete range of whole egg powder, egg albumen powder, yolk powder, pasteurized liquid eggs, and customized mixes.
- [Quality & Certifications](https://www.skmegg.com/quality-certifications) - Detailed overview of our BRCGS, ISO/IEC 17025, Halal, and Kosher quality standards.
- [Infrastructure & Facilities](https://www.skmegg.com/egg_processing_plant) - Tour our processing plant, automated poultry farms, feed mills, and advanced testing laboratories.
- [Investor Relations](https://www.skmegg.com/investors) - Corporate governance, quarterly results, annual reports, and shareholder information.
- [Brochure & Media](https://www.skmegg.com/brochure) - View and download our product lists, coffee table books, and corporate literature.
- [Contact Us](https://www.skmegg.com/contact-us) - Get in touch with our export sales, corporate offices, and customer support.
